description: Resume an existing saved session owned by the connected account. Reuses an active browser with the label, otherwise opens one metered browser with a 180-second idle timeout, restoring cookies and storage, not tabs. Only call after the user requests resume. Never retry an ambiguous allocation or change requestId to retry. Close the returned browser when finished.

requestId.description: Unique operation ID. Repeated calls for the same operation must use the same ID.

name: resume_saved_session
title: Resume a saved browser session
